scripts.build: rm -f ../ChromeBadgeDeleter.zip ../FirefoxBadgeDeleter.zip && rm -rf .firefox_src && zip -r ../ChromeBadgeDeleter.zip . -x '*.git*' 'node_modules/*' '*.env*' 'package*.json' '.firefox_src*' 'test.js' && cp manifest.json manifest_firefox.json && node -e "let m=require('./manifest_firefox.json'); m.browser_specific_settings={gecko:{id:'badgerdev@robloxbadgedeleter.com', data_collection_permissions:{required:['none']}}}; m.background.scripts=[m.background.service_worker]; require('fs').writeFileSync('manifest_firefox.json', JSON.stringify(m, null, 2));" && zip -r ../FirefoxBadgeDeleter.zip . -x '*.git*' 'manifest.json' 'node_modules/*' '*.env*' 'package*.json' '.firefox_src*' 'test.js' && printf "@ manifest_firefox.json\n@=manifest.json\n" | zipnote -w ../FirefoxBadgeDeleter.zip && rm manifest_firefox.json
scripts.deploy:firefox: rm -rf .firefox_src && unzip -q ../FirefoxBadgeDeleter.zip -d .firefox_src && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && web-ext sign --source-dir .firefox_src --artifacts-dir ../artifacts --channel listed --api-key $WEB_EXT_API_KEY --api-secret $WEB_EXT_API_SECRET && rm -rf .firefox_src
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:chrome && npm run deploy:firefox
scripts.jules:status: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && curl -s -H "x-goog-api-key: $JULES_API_KEY" https://jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha/sessions | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); (d.sessions||[]).forEach(s=>{ const pr=(s.outputs||[]).find(o=>o.pullRequest); console.log('['+(s.state||'ACTIVE')+']', s.id, '-', s.title, '\n  Live URL:', s.url, pr ? '\n  PR: '+pr.pullRequest.url : ''); });"
scripts.jules:logs: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && SID=$(curl -s -H "x-goog-api-key: $JULES_API_KEY" https://jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha/sessions | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); console.log(d.sessions[0].id);") && curl -s -H "x-goog-api-key: $JULES_API_KEY" "https://jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha/sessions/$SID/activities" | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); (d.activities||[]).forEach(a=>console.log(a.createTime, a.originator||'', JSON.stringify(a.progressUpdated||a.planGenerated||a.sessionCompleted||a.agentMessaged||a)));"
